verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents that it groups identical errors into one fault while keeping each occurrence navigable (docs-3). Grouping can be customized per exception by changing the error class, component, or stack trace, or by sending a custom fingerprint (docs-2), and a community user praises the deduping (comm-1). Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the default stack-trace fingerprinting algorithm, in-depth docs or examples for custom fingerprint configuration, and hands-on evidence of grouping at high event volumes.
